title: from_content: use looks_like_bcrypt_hash not parse_bcrypt_cost for file validation
description: store.rs from_content() validates hashes with parse_bcrypt_cost (no length check) while config startup validation and from_credentials panic guard both use looks_like_bcrypt_hash (len >= 60 + parse_bcrypt_cost). A credential file entry with a correctly-prefixed but too-short string (e.g. '$2b$10$x') passes from_content's BadHash check, silently producing a CredentialStore that rejects every auth attempt for that user with no diagnostic at load time. Fix: replace parse_bcrypt_cost with looks_like_bcrypt_hash in from_content's hash validation branch (line ~170 store.rs). No security impact (fail-closed), but operator mis-configuration is not surfaced promptly. IMAP is unaffected (no credential_file path). Affects reader only via build_credential_store -> merge_from_content/merge_from_file.
